sections.title: About this clinic
sections.html: Established in 2020, the START Mountain Region center is Utah's only dedicated community-based early-phase clinical trial site. Part of the world's largest Phase I oncology research program, the center is led by Dr. Justin Call and gives patients across the Intermountain West access to cutting-edge investigational therapies. The program expands options for patients who have exhausted standard treatments and wish to explore emerging approaches.
